sections.brief: Other Israeli officials' dated statements on Iran's timeline and on striking: Peres (1992 'warheads by 1999', 2007, Aug 2012 'go with the United States'), Barak (2009 6-18 month window, 'not existential', 2012 'zone of immunity'), Ya'alon (Dec 2010 three years), the 2010 Israeli estimate vs US 'dash' time, Gantz (2012 'very rational', 2021 ten weeks), Bennett 2021, Lapid 2022, IDF June 2025; US officials who echoed (Panetta 2011, Clinton 2016, Trump 2025). Figures: time

Israel's dissenters: Dagan (Jan 2011 no bomb before 2015; May-June 2011 'stupidest thing'; 60 Minutes 2012), the 2010 P-Plus order resisted by Ashkenazi and Dagan (Uvda 2012), Pardo (Dec 2011 'existential threat' overused; 2011 countdown order, Uvda 2018), Diskin 2012, Gantz, Ayalon and Halevy 2015, Yadlin 2021; the Oct 2012 Mossad 'Spy Cables' paper (two readings); US intelligence (NIE 2007, 2011 update and Clapper 2012, Gabbard 2025 and her 20 June walk-back, March 2026 hearing, Kent resignation); US officials against a strike (Panetta, Obama, Dempsey, Gates). Figures: compare (warning vs dissent); time
